description: Returns the status of a get_credits order by the order_id get_credits returned. Status is one of waiting, confirming, exchanging, sending, finished, failed, refunded, expired, cancelled; it also returns ChangeNOW's payout tx and credits_added once Wave credits your balance. Poll at most every 30 s. Read-only; needs sign-in as the wallet that made the order.

order_id.description: The order_id returned by get_credits, e.g. swp_...
